name: Immersion in Paradox
source: A usual student Constantine thought, that he will live his life as an ordinary person. By his nineteen years he was studying at a proper establishment and side job, which allowed to rent an apartments. But one day everything in his life changed, when he found out that he can change the course of history.
translation: 一个普通的学生康斯坦丁想，他会像一个普通人一样生活。十九岁时，他在一家正规机构学习并从事副业，可以租一套公寓。但有一天，当他发现自己可以改变历史的进程时，他生活中的一切都改变了。
